burrata.name: Burrata & heirloom tomatoes
burrata.short: Creamy burrata, ripe tomatoes, grilled sourdough.
burrata.description: A soft ball of fresh burrata, sweet heirloom tomatoes and basil, finished with olive oil. Scoop it up with warm grilled sourdough.
burrata.ingredients: Burrata (milk), tomatoes, basil, olive oil, sourdough (wheat), sea salt.

dumplings.name: Chili-crisp dumplings
dumplings.short: Golden vegetable dumplings, chili oil, scallions.
dumplings.description: Six pan-seared vegetable dumplings with crisp bottoms and a soft center. Finished with chili oil and scallions, with soy dipping sauce on the side.
dumplings.ingredients: Wheat wrappers, cabbage, mushrooms, carrot, scallions, soy sauce (soy, wheat), sesame, chili oil.

pasta.name: Tomato & basil rigatoni
pasta.description: Ridged pasta tossed in a rich, slow-roasted tomato sauce, with fresh basil and vegetarian parmesan. Comforting, simple, and made for a long lunch.
pasta.ingredients: Rigatoni (wheat), tomatoes, basil, vegetarian parmesan (milk), olive oil, garlic.

salad.name: Roasted garden bowl
salad.description: Roasted beets and sweet potato over crisp greens, with chickpeas, bright citrus and fresh herbs. A lemon dressing brings it all together.
salad.ingredients: Beets, sweet potato, chickpeas, citrus, greens, parsley, mint, sesame, lemon, olive oil.

chicken.name: Lemon & herb chicken
chicken.short: Golden chicken, baby potatoes, green beans.
chicken.description: Herb-roasted chicken with crisp skin, baby potatoes and green beans. Served with a light lemon and olive-oil jus.
chicken.ingredients: Chicken, potatoes, green beans, lemon, olive oil, rosemary, thyme, garlic.

cake.name: Chocolate ganache cake
cake.short: Dark chocolate, vanilla cream, fresh raspberry.
cake.description: A rich slice of chocolate layer cake with a glossy dark chocolate ganache. A little vanilla cream and fresh raspberry on the side.
cake.ingredients: Chocolate, wheat flour, eggs, butter (milk), cream (milk), sugar, vanilla, raspberry.

lemonade.name: Strawberry basil lemonade
lemonade.short: Fresh strawberry, lemon, basil & sparkling water.
lemonade.description: A bright, lightly sparkling lemonade with fresh strawberries, a squeeze of lemon and fragrant basil. Served over ice.
lemonade.ingredients: Strawberry, lemon, basil, cane sugar, sparkling water, ice.

tea.name: Jasmine iced tea
tea.short: Floral jasmine tea, lemon, plenty of ice.
tea.description: Freshly brewed jasmine tea, chilled and served over ice with lemon. Unsweetened, with a gentle floral finish.
tea.ingredients: Jasmine tea, lemon, filtered water, ice. Contains caffeine.

deal.name: Lunch special
deal.description: A starter, a main & a drink.
